what: slope: An R Package Identify Slope Patterns and Processes
title: slope: An R Package for Identify Slope Patterns and Processes
text: Slope package provides different geomorphometric approaches detecting slope forms patterns, based nine type básics (Dikau, 1989), roughness concentration index (Sampaio Augustin, 2014), Ridges, Tops Valleys (Silveira Silveira, 2020), debris flow (slider) dynamics based Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), geomorphic change detection (Wheaton et al. 2010) dissection index (Evans, 1972).

title: Slope Forms — slopeforms
text: Detects nine landform elements based Dikau (1989).  code refers specific pattern slope forms.  code refers specific pattern slope forms: 11: Concave-Concave slope (hollows). 12: Concave-Concave slope. 13: Concave-Convex slope. 21: Concave-Straight slope. 22: Straight-Straight slope. 23: Convex-Straight slope. 31: Concave-Convex slope. 32: Straight-Convex slope. 33: Convex-Convex slope.
